citation.title: Anteroposterior dysplasia indicator: an adjunct to cephalometric differential diagnosis

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare exit 1). Every value re-read from the page image of Table I, p. 623 (PDF p. 5), Group 1 columns: 86.30/3.25, 5.23/3.71, -5.84/2.76, 80.62/3.55, 77.32/3.29, 3.30/1.82, 0.89/3.32, 25.91/5.58, 24.57/5.25, 125.88/6.40, 60.11/3.44, -0.33/2.73, 81.37/3.79 - all match both extractors. Differences settled: (1) population.id a='caucasian' b='analysis-own' -> analysis-own (every analysis-own set uses it; Caucasian goes in ethnicity, p. 620). (2) #22 a='same' b='close' -> 'same': the paper does not define its mandibular plane; Kim's is the lower-border tangent (merge notes; Kim 1974 p. 589), noted on the entry. (3) #25 MMPA a='same' b='close' -> 'close' (tangent vs the catalogue's Go-Me). (4) #36 gonial a='same' b='close' -> 'close' (Kim's tangent-line gonial angle vs Ar-Go-Me). Added after checking the paper (neither extractor had it): ageBand [8,14] - p. 620: 51 boys and 51 girls aged 8 to 14, mean 11 years 6 months (Table I age row 11.6); both extractors left the band off although they entered Kim 1974's [7,14]. Group 1 only (normal occlusion); Groups 2-4 are malocclusion groups, not norms. Scale not-stated.

caveats: Group 1 only (p. 620): 102 Caucasian children with normal occlusion, 51 boys and 51 girls, 8 to 14 years (mean 11 years 6 months, SD 1.59). Groups 2-4 (neutroclusion, distoclusion, mesioclusion; 874 malocclusions) are not norms and are not entered.
The paper does not define its mandibular plane or gonial angle; they are read as Kim's own (Kim 1974: lower-border tangent; tangent-line gonial angle).
Not in the catalogue, not entered: molar displacement (study-model measurement, mm).
Film scale and head position are not stated; the Wits (mm) row is used as printed (assumed true size, owner ruling M-2).

entries.note: Defined as the distance from AO to BO along the occlusal plane, after Jacobson (p. 622, item 13). Sign as the catalogue's: the distoclusion group reads +3.16, the mesioclusion group -4.97.
entries.definitionNote: Measured on the functional occlusal plane (through the premolars); this app measures Wits on the occlusal plane through the molars and incisors (since 16 Oct 2026)

entries.source: Table I, p. 623, Group 1 (normal occlusion), row 14 'APDI'
entries.note: Facial angle plus or minus the A-B plane angle, and again plus or minus the palatal plane angle (p. 622, item 14). Summary p. 632 gives 81.4 +- 3.79.
